## Summary

Describe the problem, behavior change, and related issue.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test` against the intended running server
- [ ] `npm run test:ui` for UI changes
- [ ] Docker build/start and endpoint verification for runtime/container changes
- [ ] On-server documentation and README updated
- [ ] Authentication rejection, TLS, HEAD/Range and encoding behavior considered
- [ ] No real credentials, private keys, request dumps or generated files committed
- [ ] Dependency/license changes and audit advisories described

List exact commands and results, including checks not run and why.

## Operational effects

Describe changes to certificates/trust, ports, network access, logging, fixture
data, dependencies and compatibility. Attach sanitized UI evidence if useful.
